events.text: Orchard Supply formed as a non-profit farmers cooperative.

events.text: Co-op moved to a larger location at 44 Vine St, San Jose.

evidence.quote: In 1933 the co-op moved to a larger location at 44 Vine St

events.text: Company moved to a site at 720 West San Carlos St, San Jose.

evidence.quote: OSH donated the boxcar to the California Trolley and Railroad Corporation in 2013

events.text: Expanded beyond California, opening stores in Portland area, Oregon.
